svg.title: How a tool call reaches Bedrock
svg.desc: How a tool call reaches Bedrock. 9 components in 4 groups. Connections: MCP client to 8 MCP tools (JSON-RPC over stdio); 8 MCP tools to Model registries (list models); 8 MCP tools to API wrappers; API wrappers to Model registries (alias, region, request shape); API wrappers to Bedrock client; Bedrock client to Amazon Bedrock (Converse, InvokeModel); Bedrock client to Amazon Bedrock (InvokeModel, StartAsyncInvoke); Amazon Bedrock to Video output bucket (writes MP4); API wrappers to Local PNG files (decoded PNG).

text.tspan: HOW A TOOL CALL REACHES BEDROCK
One stdio MCP server, one cached SDK client per region, and a cancelled tool call aborts its Bedrock request
